# Gym OS
> Gym OS is a gym management operating system for Indian gyms, built by Beyond Pixells
> (product studio, India). WhatsApp-native: members never download an app.

## Core Capabilities
- WhatsApp automation suite (36 flows): renewal reminders, payment links, win-backs
- QR check-in, attendance streaks, trial passes
- Unified lead CRM (website + WhatsApp + walk-in), duplicate detection, consent capture
- Owner command center: revenue, attendance, P&L, AI churn-risk insights
- Branded website designed by the studio, included with every rollout
- India-native: UPI collection, GST invoices, flat INR pricing, unlimited members

## Pricing
- One-time setup + flat monthly: Starter ₹999/mo, Growth ₹1,999/mo, Chain custom.
- No per-member fees. Prices ex-GST.

## Facts
- Running in 8 branded gym systems
- 32-module product spec; 45+ data entities in production
- Every client site captures leads with offline fallback (no lead lost)
